County.title: County Record
County.description: Authoritative demographics, cardiac registry, and emergency transport statistics for a US county across all 3,143 nationwide counties.

countyName.description: Full name of the county, parish, or borough.

seniorPopPct.description: Percentage of population age 65 and older.

averageTransportMinutes.description: Average EMS drive time to emergency department.

primaryCathLabDistanceMiles.description: Distance in miles to nearest STEMI PCI Cardiac Catheterization Lab.

activeEmsAgencies.description: Number of licensed EMS and Fire agencies.

Agency.title: EMS & Fire Agency
Agency.description: Comprehensive operational, clinical NEMSIS, CMS billing, apparatus fleet, and federal grant intelligence for Fire and EMS providers across all 3,143 counties.

name.description: Official department or EMS agency name.

fdid.description: State Fire Department Identification or EMS licensing number.

agencyType.description: Provider operational classification (Career Fire Department, Combination, Third Service EMS, Private Hospital-Based).

jurisdictionLevel.description: Administrative jurisdiction level (Local, County, Regional, State).

providerCategory.description: Primary service branch (EMS Provider or Fire Department).

populationServed.description: Total resident population within first-due response jurisdiction.

totalAmbulances.description: Number of active Type I, Type II, and Type III ALS/BLS transport units.

totalFireEngines.description: Number of Class A rescue pumpers, quints, and aerial apparatus.

stationsCount.description: Total active fire stations and EMS deployment bases.

annual911Transports.description: Total annual patient transports to receiving emergency departments.

annualCardiacArrestCalls.description: Annual out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) resuscitations attempted (NEMSIS).

bystanderCPRRate.description: NEMSIS registry benchmark for citizen bystander CPR before EMS arrival.

utsteinSurvivalRate.description: CARES/NEMSIS Utstein cardiac arrest survival to hospital discharge rate percentage.

cmsData.description: CMS open ambulance reimbursement and Medicare/Medicaid billing intelligence.

claimDenialRate.description: Percentage of Medicare claims rejected or denied.

medicareBilledAnnual.description: Annual dollar amount billed to CMS Medicare Part B.

medicareAllowedAnnual.description: Annual dollar amount allowed by CMS Medicare Part B fee schedule.

estimatedRecoverableRevenue.description: Projected annual revenue recoverable through clinical documentation and ePCR denial defense.

commercialPayerMixPct.description: Commercial private health insurance payer mix percentage.

gadcsReportingStatus.description: CMS Ground Ambulance Data Collection System (GADCS) compliance audit status.

installedFleet.description: Installed cardiac monitor/defibrillator fleet, CAD vendor, and ePCR infrastructure.

defibBrand.description: Incumbent monitor/defibrillator vendor (e.g. Stryker LIFEPAK 15, ZOLL X Series, Philips MRx).

defibAgeYears.description: Average age in years of the active defib fleet.

defibWarrantyStatus.description: Manufacturer warranty status (Active, Expired, Third-Party ISO).

dispatchCadVendor.description: 911 Computer-Aided Dispatch software vendor (CentralSquare, Tyler New World, Hexagon, Motorola).

epcrCadSoftware.description: Electronic patient care reporting software (ZOLL emsCharts, ImageTrend Elite, ESO).

grantStatus.description: FEMA Assistance to Firefighters Grants (AFG) and federal funding status.

afgAwarded.description: Indicates whether the agency has an active or recent FEMA AFG grant.

afgAwardAmount.description: Total federal grant dollar funding awarded.

afgFiscalYear.description: Grant federal fiscal award year (e.g. 2025 or 2026).

afgPurpose.description: FEMA approved procurement category (Operations & Safety, Vehicle Acquisition, Equipment).

zollOpportunity.description: Predictive PulseIQ scoring and sales pipeline opportunity.

pulseIqScore.description: Algorithmic score from 0 to 100 predicting sales readiness.

salesStage.description: CRM pipeline stage (Target Lead, Discovery, Clinical Evaluation, RFP Issued, Proposal Delivered, Closed Won).

projectedPipelineValue.description: Total addressable opportunity value in US dollars.

FieldNote.title: Field Note
FieldNote.description: Logged field visit, station meeting, or territory interaction note.

notes.description: Detailed notes from the field call.

/counties/{countyFips}.description: National directory of 3,143 US counties, demographics, and emergency transport statistics.

/agencies/{agencyId}.description: Active CRM directory of EMS and Fire Department accounts across all counties with CMS, NEMSIS, and grant analytics.

/field_notes/{noteId}.description: Field logs and station visit interaction records.
